description: Search the Where to use them catalog by free text — where to use lab products — the public site, CuNi Studio, Agent-Rider, TeachAid, and this MCP server. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use surface_get when you already know the entry id.

q.description: Free-text query matched against entry id, name, notes, price, and URL. Omit or send an empty string to list every entry in the catalog.

name: surface_search
